name: Cloud resource deletion guard
summary: Block high-confidence direct cloud CLI deletion, termination, and purge operations.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that recognizes explicit destructive AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure CLI verbs while allowing their list, describe, show, and get operations.
refuses: It does not delete, restore, snapshot, or inspect cloud resources.
It does not infer whether an account or resource is production.
It does not accept confirmation flags or prompt text as authorization.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize direct cloud CLI deletion verbs without contacting provider APIs.
